name: @docxtor/core
description: Docxtor's lossless .docx engine: open, edit with ops, save. Runs in browsers, Node, Deno and edge runtimes.

scripts.wasm: cd ../.. && RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" wasm-pack build crates/docxtor-wasm --target web --release --no-opt --out-dir ../../packages/core/wasm --out-name docxtor && rm -f packages/core/wasm/.gitignore packages/core/wasm/package.json && node scripts/strip-wasm-names.mjs packages/core/wasm/docxtor_bg.wasm
scripts.wasm:ship: cd ../.. && RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=~" wasm-pack build crates/docxtor-wasm --target web --profile wasm-ship --no-opt --out-dir ../../packages/core/wasm --out-name docxtor && rm -f packages/core/wasm/.gitignore packages/core/wasm/package.json && node scripts/strip-wasm-names.mjs packages/core/wasm/docxtor_bg.wasm
